about: A touchpad's flick gliding, for the gate's timing phase and perf.py's desktop (docs/performance.mdx, docs/desktop-interaction-coverage.mdx): touchpad-hold.json's first flick (sample/GlideProbe.tsx): the list glides its Android distance, its scrolls stamped as they are dispatched, and its momentum's frames come a refresh apart (`glide`'s `frame_gap_ms`, [median, most], held with --speed-budgets), the host's input to present for the fingers' scrolls within its budget (`diagnostics`).

steps.name: a flick glides its distance, every scroll event stamped when it was dispatched

texts: Glide 1: scrolls stamped rising yes, momentum stamped yes, ended at 387
